rule: docs/ARC4_V85_PROTOCOL_EN.md A.10.1(e), §11: plateaus of >= 1M billed frames without a new best record
claim_header: Every v85 claim concerns a SEARCH WITH BILLED REWINDS (savestates; 60 frames per restore; every emulated frame of the agent billed). It starts from a savestate shared by all arms: a state, chosen by the evaluator, at the game's first matched rung M1 on an earlier V2 run's lineage that reached the top rung. The root's sensed rise is set to that lineage's own sensed rise and is identical for all arms. It uses the senses granted on 22 October 2026: pixels, its own buttons, max(0, r_step) per step, lives. Evaluator instruments (D, O, K*) additionally use unbilled look-ahead or future-path data, reported as oracle frames; they are not agents. It is not live play without savestates.

senses.root_S: S(s1): the reference lineage's own sensed rise, identical for all arms
senses.instruments: evaluator only (ragnarok/evaluation/), never agents: unbilled look-ahead or future-path data, reported as oracle frames
